note: Cross-platform GPX writer fixtures (EPIC-12). gpx-input-v1.json is the shared INPUT: both suites build their own workout/route/point objects from it, run their own GPXWriter/GpxWriter, and must produce the route_*.gpx goldens byte for byte. Read by apps/ios/Tests/GPXAggregationParityTests.swift and apps/android/app/src/test/java/net/albayyan/badan/GpxAggregationParityTest.kt. Neither suite may copy the records or goldens into its own source — a copy is one more thing that can drift from the artifact it polices (same reasoning as packages/fixtures/export). Regenerating: see README.md; the switch always fails the run so a rewrite can never be mistaken for a pass.
